Subject: Inventory gap analysis + seat reallocation plan for upcoming GitHub / JetBrains / Jira renewals

Hi team,

We have the renewal windows for GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains All Products Pack, and Atlassian (Jira + Confluence) coming up over the next 90 days for several internal business units. Orbit Labs' procurement asked for a consolidated view of seats, active integrations, and any unused licenses so they can prioritize spend.

Attached is a preliminary export (tool_inventory_q2_2027.csv) from RDW asset service. Can each of you do a quick pass on your areas by EOD Thursday? Specifically: 
- Ben: confirm active GH orgs and which repos are on dedicated plans vs. org-wide seats.
- Karthik: pull JetBrains seat assignment and which teams have per-seat vs floating licenses.
- Marissa: surface any Jira projects with low MAU and Confluence spaces we can archive or consolidate.

Goal: produce a short reallocation proposal (1 page) with recommended seat moves and expected savings that procurement can include in their negotiation posture. Procurement copied here will use it to request firm quotes and an early DocuSign for renewal windows.

Thanks — Evelyn

Eve — quick pass attached. I filtered GH orgs into three buckets in ghe_license_map.xlsx: dedicated enterprise seats, contractor-only orgs, and archived repos. Highlights:
- Enterprise org (redwood-main): 820 seats assigned, 120 seats inactive longer than 90 days (based on last commit/activity).
- Contractors & integrations (devops-extern): 160 seats; we can switch to SSO-limited access or move to time-bound seats on renewal.
- Archived repos: ~40 repos with no activity in 12+ months; owners listed in column G.

Actionable asks:
1) Approve temporary 120-seat reallocation from redwood-main to the contractor pool for the next 30 days while we complete audits.
2) Approve removal of 40 archived repo seats and open reclamation ticket to confirm no legal holds.

Attachment: ghe_license_map.xlsx

Ben

Thanks for the inventory — this is helpful. Quick responses from JetBrains side: 
- We can offer a 30-day grace pool for floating licenses to cover contractor fluctuation; no additional invoicing until seats stabilize.
- If you can provide a confirmed list of 40 archived-seat owner emails, we will accept a single bulk reclaim and credit those seats back to your account (credit typically appears on next invoice).

I'll prepare a preliminary bundled quote that models: current spend, proposed reallocation (120 seats to contractor pool + reclaim 40), and a 12-month smoothing plan. Can we book a 30-minute sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to walk through the quote? I've attached a short FAQ and a sample seat reallocation PDF (seat_reorg_proposal_v1.pdf).

Best,
Sara
